moves.what: Reordered the per-exercise overflow menu (ExerciseCard.jsx) in WorkoutDetail and QuickWorkout: Replace exercise now leads, ahead of Add notes and How to. Remove exercise (destructive) stays anchored last, unchanged.
moves.from: Add notes, How to, Replace exercise, [Add daily min set], Remove exercise
moves.to: Replace exercise, Add notes, How to, [Add daily min set], Remove exercise
moves.why: Replace exercise is the routine mid-session workaround for an equipment-day swap or a taken machine — wishes.json already calls it 'a core mid-session workaround... routine, not rare path.' It sat third, behind two lower-frequency items (per-exercise notes, cues). Pure reorder of existing items, no new controls, no logic change.

proposals.what: Skip creating a workout_sessions row on /quick-workout until the first exercise is added (or skip the Resume dialog when exercises is empty).
proposals.why: Behavior/logic change (session-creation timing), not a within-screen reorder — out of scope for this pass. Already captured in wishes.json.

proposals.what: Make manual-Finish log_date and stale-session auto-finish log_date agree for workouts that cross local midnight.
proposals.why: A data/engine semantics decision (which timestamp is 'right'), not a UI move — out of scope. Already the r1-08 finding/proposal and in wishes.json.

proposals.what: Add a 'Log a quick workout instead' escape hatch on the WorkoutDetail 'Workout not found' dead-end (currently only 'Back to Workouts').
proposals.why: This is a new link into a different screen/flow, not a reorder of what's already on the page — explicitly out of scope ('moving a feature to a different screen', 'new features'). Already in wishes.json.

proposals.what: Enforce reps/RIR ceilings in the onChange handlers, matching the weight-field fix already shipped (r1-01 only covered weight; the HTML max on reps/RIR is still decorative).
proposals.why: A validation/engine-adjacent bug fix, not a UX position move — flag for a future round's fix pass rather than this pass.
